headline: Vote on updated operating protocols and an update on the O'Maley HVAC work.
summary: A Program Subcommittee report covers the operating protocols, followed by a vote on the updated version. Enrollment, the superintendent's report, and the O'Maley HVAC update are also listed.
items: Gloucester High School Student Advisory Council presentation
Consent agenda: warrants, transfers, and donations
Program Subcommittee report on School Committee Operating Protocols
Vote on updated Gloucester School Committee Operating Protocols
Discussion and old and new business
location: Gloucester High School Library, 32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930
